name: agentic-trust
description: Public Claude Code plugin marketplace for the Agentic Trust network: the open, anonymous, rate-limited enforcement gateway that verifies MM-issued agent credentials on Concordium (restricted issuer / open verifier — ADR-70).

plugins.name: agent-gateway
plugins.description: Wires the hosted Agentic Trust gateway MCP so any Claude Code agent can route privileged calls through the open, anonymous, rate-limited enforcement layer that verifies MM-issued CIS-4/CIS-8004 credentials on Concordium. No key, no auth, no account.
